Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in interpreting the definition of "sunrise" in the context of the question. In Step 10, the Planner incorrectly assumed that "sunrise" refers to the event at a specific "polar reference location" where the sun rises only once a year (during the transition from polar night to polar day). This is a misinterpretation of the general concept of sunrise. For the vast majority of the Earth's surface (and for the general definition of the event), sunrise occurs daily. By arbitrarily switching the frame of reference to a polar location to make the answer "Full Moon" fit, the Planner contradicted the earlier correct understanding (Step 4) that sunrise occurs daily. This led to a false comparison where the Planner claimed Full Moon (12-13 times/year) is more frequent than Sunrise (1 time/year at poles), whereas in reality, Sunrise (daily) is the most frequent event among the options. The error stems from a logical flaw in defining the scope of the event rather than a failure to retrieve data.
